name: smartattend
description: Smart attendance via rotating QR codes, with proxy-marking defences.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,ml -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n server,web,ml -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:https -w web" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.train: node scripts/py.mjs train_proxy.py && node scripts/py.mjs train_atrisk.py
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:ml
